title: Jailbreak and adversarial robustness
bottleneck: Despite massive investment, aligned models remain jailbreakable via encoding tricks, multi-turn manipulation, and novel attack strategies — each patch is followed by new bypasses. Adversarial robustness in deep learning has resisted decades of effort in vision and now in language; the attack surface of an open-ended conversational model may be fundamentally uncloseable. Formal guarantees of robustness don't exist for frontier models.
why_it_blocks: Safety training that can be bypassed with a clever prompt provides no real guarantee, especially as models gain tool access where a jailbreak becomes a cyberattack. Until instruction hierarchy is architectural rather than conventional, every agent with tools remains an injection target.
current_state: Automated red-teaming finds new jailbreaks continuously and defenses are reactive. No deployed model is robust against a determined adversary.

sources.title: The Persistence of Vulnerability: Unsolved Challenges in Artificial Intelligence Risk Management (2016–2026)
